closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, usually beats ultra-processed sweet snacks, and easy to use as a whole food, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low vitamin A, and low iron. It is good for practical meals, digestion, and low-calorie volume because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
